paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Comparison of massive activations and attention sink phenomena across different gating configurations. Row 1 (Baseline): Significant massive activations and attention sinks emerge after the 6th layer. Row 2 (SDPA Gating): Reduced activations and no attention sinks observed. Row 3 (Value Layer Gating): Similar activations to Row 2 but with residual attention sinks. Rows 4–5 (Reduced Sparsity via cross-head share and NS-sigmoid): Massive activations and attention sinks resemble the baseline.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Фигурата илюстрира промените във вниманието на първия токен по слоеве за базовата конфигурация (baseline), като показва как се изменя вниманието на първия токен в зависимост от номера на слоя. Ос X е обозначена като „layer“ и представлява дискретни стойности от 0 до 22, с равномерно разположени етикети на всяко цяло число. Ос Y е обозначена като „first token attention score“ и показва стойности от 0.0 до 1.0 с равномерен интервал от 0.2; скалата е линейна. На графиката са представени две линии: синята сплошна линия, означена като „first token attention score“, започва със стойност около 0.05 при слой 0, постепенно расте до около 0.1 при слой 3, след което рязко се увеличава до около 0.65 при слой 6 и продължава да варира между 0.4 и 0.8 до слой 22, като включва върхове около 0.85 при слой 21 и спад до около 0.4 при слой 22. Втората линия е зелена пунктирна линия, означена като „mean: 0.467“, която представлява хоризонтална права линия, която преминава през стойност 0.467 по оста Y и се простира от слой 0 до слой 22.
model_annotations.Chinese: The line chart illustrates the first token attention scores across different layers for a baseline model, with the x-axis representing the layer number ranging from 0 to 22 in integer steps, and the y-axis showing the first token attention score on a scale from 0.0 to 1.0. A solid blue line plots the attention scores, which begin near 0.05 at layer 0, increase gradually to approximately 0.1 at layer 4, then spike sharply to about 0.66 at layer 6. After this peak, the scores fluctuate between roughly 0.4 and 0.85 across subsequent layers, with notable peaks at layers 18 (approximately 0.75), 21 (approximately 0.85), and a dip at layer 22 (approximately 0.45). A dashed green line is drawn horizontally at a y-value of 0.467, labeled as the mean attention score, which remains constant across all layers.
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the first token attention scores across different layers for the baseline model configuration, as part of a broader comparison of gating mechanisms in large language models. The x-axis, labeled "layer," spans from 0 to 22 in integer steps, representing the model's layer depth. The y-axis, labeled "first token attention score," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, indicating the attention weight assigned to the first token at each layer. A solid blue line traces the attention score trend, which begins near 0.05 at layer 0, rises sharply to approximately 0.67 at layer 6, and then fluctuates between roughly 0.4 and 0.85 across subsequent layers, peaking near 0.85 at layer 21 before declining to about 0.45 at layer 22. A dashed green line, labeled "mean: 0.467," represents the average attention score across all layers and remains constant at 0.467, serving as a reference point. The plot visually highlights the emergence of significant attention sinks—layers where the first token receives disproportionately high attention—after layer 6, consistent with the caption's observation of massive activations and attention sink phenomena in the baseline configuration.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die Aufmerksamkeitswerte des ersten Tokens für verschiedene Schichten in einem Baseline-Modell, wobei die x-Achse die Schicht (layer) von 0 bis etwa 23 in ganzzahligen Abständen darstellt und die y-Achse den Aufmerksamkeitswert des ersten Tokens von 0.0 bis 1.0 in linearen Schritten anzeigt. Eine durchgezogene blaue Linie repräsentiert die Aufmerksamkeitswerte des ersten Tokens, die bei Schicht 0 bei etwa 0.05 beginnen, leicht ansteigen, bis sie bei Schicht 5 auf etwa 0.10 ansteigen, dann bei Schicht 6 abrupt auf etwa 0.65 ansteigen, um danach eine schwankende Entwicklung mit einem Gipfel von etwa 0.85 bei Schicht 21 zu zeigen, bevor sie bei Schicht 23 auf etwa 0.42 abfallen. Eine gestrichelte grüne Linie, die den Mittelwert der Aufmerksamkeitswerte bei 0.467 darstellt, verläuft horizontal durch das Diagramm und bleibt konstant bei diesem Wert.
